ata.title: Flight Compartment Wiring — Overhead Panel Wiring

abstract: Wiring diagram for the overhead panel, showing the probe heat control and monitoring circuit including the per-element sense returns added by the monitoring modification.

sections.purpose: This sheet shows the overhead panel wiring for the probe heat control and monitoring circuit, from the selector switch through the computer to the probe supply and the sense returns.
sections.sheet_note: The sense return arrangement differs by embodiment standard: the original circuit carries one return for each probe and the post-modification circuit carries one return for each heating element, which needs two additional contacts at the computer connector. The two arrangements are drawn on separate sheets and the sheet applicable to an aircraft must be selected from its embodiment record rather than from its delivery date, because the retrofit was not applied in serial order.
sections.routing_note: The circuit leaves the overhead panel through the crown break-out and runs forward to the computer position in the avionics compartment. The probe supply legs drop down the forward frame webs to each probe base. The sense returns share the supply harness but are on the screened core group, which is earthed at the computer end only.
